description: This Java source file defines the ApplicationCurrencyRepositoryWrapper class, which provides methods to retrieve ApplicationCurrency entities from a data repository with built-in not-found exception handling. It acts as a wrapper around ApplicationCurrencyRepository to simplify currency retrieval with error detection.

classes.name: ApplicationCurrencyRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service wrapper for ApplicationCurrencyRepository that provides methods to find ApplicationCurrency instances with automatic not-found exception handling.

methods.name: ApplicationCurrencyRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ApplicationCurrencyRepository dependency.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves an ApplicationCurrency by MonetaryCurrency object, throws CurrencyNotFoundException if not found, and maps it to a new ApplicationCurrency with specified decimal and multiple settings.

methods.description: Retrieves an ApplicationCurrency by currency code string, throws CurrencyNotFoundException if not found.
